stepBody: He starts by training a model using only demographic information. Parth experimentally determines the bias and variance of his model: he finds the bias is $$5$$ and the variance is $$4$$. Parth read that the measurement error from the surveys has mean $$0$$. If he wants to keep his model risk to be no higher than $$38$$, what is the maximum standard deviation in his data that would be acceptable? Your answer should be a single number.
